items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The curate makes three Celestial Radiance attacks.

items.name: Celestial Radiance
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

items.name: Healer's Touch
items.notes: The curate touches another creature. That creature regains 13 (2d8 + 4) Hit Points.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The curate has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Raise the Dead
items.notes: In a ritual that takes 8 hours, the curate touches a creature that has died within the past 7 days. That creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The curate can't revive a creature that died of old age.

items.name: Pseudopod
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage.

items.name: Amorphous
items.notes: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

items.name: Corrosive Form
items.notes: Whenever a creature hits the ooze with a melee attack, that creature takes 2 Acid damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Ivlis makes three Chaos Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Sinister Command if available.

items.name: Chaos Blast
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) damage. Roll 1d4 to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

items.name: Sinister Command
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 12, one creature Ivlis can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Jacko makes two Poison Dagger attacks.

items.name: Poison Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Cunning Action
items.notes: Jacko takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Quick Disguise
items.notes: Jacko spends 1 minute to disguise himself as a different Humanoid of approximately his height and weight. While Jacko is disguised, a creature that takes the Study action to inspect Jacko's appearance can make a DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) check, discerning his disguise on a successful check.

items.name: Brine Slicer
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

items.name: Slippery
items.notes: The kuo-toa takes the Disengage action.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Bone Pike attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Bone Pike
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Poison Spit
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Poison damage.

items.name: Hold Breath
items.notes: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Narthus makes two attacks using Vile Mace or Fateful Bolt in any combination.

items.name: Vile Mace
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Fateful Bolt
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Narthus's next turn has Advantage.

items.name: Rapier
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: Pral is hit with a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Pral adds 2 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

items.name: Needle Sword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.name: Enchanting Bow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

items.name: Heart Sight
items.notes: Charisma saving throw DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, Undead automatically fail the save). On a failed save, The sprite knows the target's emotions.

items.name: Invisibility
items.notes: The sprite has the Invisible condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the sprite makes an attack roll or deals damage, or if the sprite has the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Vinx makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Sling in any combination.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Sling
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Drink Life.

items.name: Necrotic Sword
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Necrotic Bow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

items.name: Drink Life
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. On a failed save, 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the wight regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

items.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
items.notes: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
